allowed_public_data_classes: Protocols, schemas, configuration, source hashes, and reproducibility manifests
Aggregate counts and rates that contain no source pixels or appearance descriptions
Accepted-only, non-pixel crossing-event ledgers after registered review and detached sign-off
De-identified numerical method-audit tables whose local tracker tokens are confined to this single video
Synthetic simulation inputs, run-level summaries, aggregate results, charts, and non-pixel schematics
Three exact-hash Task 1 screenshots embedded only in the assessment slide deck to evidence the supplied-video inference workflow
restricted_data_classes: The supplied source video or audio
Decoded frames, crops, thumbnails, contact sheets, review videos, and evidence packets that reproduce source pixels, except the exact-hash assessment screenshots explicitly approved below
Faces, face templates, biometric features, appearance descriptions, identity embeddings, or re-identification features
Cross-camera or cross-dataset identity links and persistent person identifiers
Raw review-item history, reviewer free-text notes, and private alias-to-person mappings
Unapproved raw or intermediate experiment exports

task1_public_artifacts.reviewer_alias_rule: Use a project-scoped role alias only; never publish a name, email address, employee identifier, phone number, or reusable cross-project handle.
task1_public_artifacts.event_id_scope: Ledger-local crossing event only; it must not be used as a stable person identifier.

retention_and_deletion.restricted_working_artifacts: Keep only for registered review, issue resolution, and submission verification. Delete within 30 calendar days after the later of final submission and closure of the assessment/review window, unless the assessment issuer requires earlier deletion or a documented legal hold applies.
retention_and_deletion.reviewer_alias_mapping: Keep locally and access-controlled only if accountability requires it; never commit it. Delete with the restricted review package when no longer required.
retention_and_deletion.public_non_pixel_artifacts: Protocols, hashes, aggregate data, signed accepted-event ledgers, and reproducible simulation summaries may be retained as the public audit record.
retention_and_deletion.deletion_evidence: Record the deletion date and artifact classes, not filenames containing personal information or source pixels.
